name: MonarchCommentThread
title: CommentThread
wrapsNative: VStack of MonarchMessageRow comments (each with .contextMenu for Delete), a MonarchButton fold and Resolve button, a MonarchMessageComposer reply field and .confirmationDialog(_:isPresented:titleVisibility:presenting:actions:message:) before deleting
summary: One threaded discussion: the starting comment, replies with older ones folded, an optional quote, Resolve and Reopen, and a reply field that stays busy while the app saves.
whenToUse: A discussion anchored to one item and shown in place: a sheet opened from a highlighted passage, a card under a field, a ticket's detail screen. Review flows where threads are resolved when settled.
whenNotToUse: For a chat conversation use MonarchVirtualMessageList with MonarchMessageRow and MonarchMessageComposer. For a list of many threads with filters use a List of threads that each push a screen holding this view.
api: init(_ comments: [MonarchCommentThreadComment], quote: String? = nil, isResolved: Bool = false, visibleReplies: Int = 3, now: Date? = nil, labels: MonarchCommentThreadLabels = MonarchCommentThreadLabels(), onResolvedChange: (@MainActor (Bool) async throws -> Void)? = nil, onDelete: (@MainActor (String) async throws -> Void)? = nil, onReply: (@MainActor (String) async throws -> Void)? = nil)

struct MonarchCommentThreadComment: Identifiable, Sendable, Hashable { init(id: String, author: String, body: String, createdAt: Date, avatarURL: URL? = nil, seed: String? = nil, canDelete: Bool = false) }

struct MonarchCommentThreadLabels: Sendable { init(thread:quote:showEarlier:earlierShown:reply:replyPlaceholder:send:resolve:reopen:resolved:resolvedHint:resolvedNotice:reopenedNotice:sentNotice:actionFailed:delete:deleteTitle:deleteMessage:cancel:), every parameter optional }

options.name: comments
options.description: The comments, oldest first. The first starts the thread; the rest are replies.

options.name: quote
options.description: The passage the thread is about, shown above it beside a bar.

options.name: isResolved
options.description: Shows the Resolved badge, makes the button Reopen and replaces the reply field with a hint.

options.name: visibleReplies
options.description: The latest replies kept visible; older ones fold behind "Show N earlier replies". One folded reply is never hidden.

options.name: now
options.description: Fixes "now" for the relative times, for tests and previews. The clock by default.

options.name: onResolvedChange
options.description: Resolves (true) or reopens the thread. Adds the Resolve button, which shows a spinner while it runs.

options.name: onDelete
options.description: Deletes the comment with this id after a confirmation dialog. Adds Delete to the context menu of comments with canDelete.

options.name: onReply
options.description: Posts the trimmed reply. Adds the reply field. The text clears when it returns and stays when it throws.

states.name: open
states.description: Resolve button (when onResolvedChange is given) and the reply field (when onReply is given).

states.name: folded
states.description: Between the first comment and the latest replies a ghost button reads "Show N earlier replies"; activating it shows them all and announces it.

states.name: resolved
states.description: A success Resolved badge with a check, the button reads Reopen, and the reply field is replaced by "This thread is resolved. Reopen it to reply."

states.name: busy
states.description: Resolve shows a spinner and the other buttons are disabled; the reply field shows its sending state until onReply returns.

states.name: failed
states.description: A danger inline notice "That didn't work. Try again." is shown and announced; a reply keeps its text.

states.name: deleting
states.description: Delete in a comment's context menu opens a system confirmation dialog with a destructive Delete comment and Cancel.

states.name: empty
states.description: With no comments only the top row and the reply field are shown, so the first comment can be written.

appearance: Comments use MonarchMessageRow (default text for author and body, muted text for the time). The quote is muted text beside a bar in the strong border colour. The resolved badge uses the success tone; a failure uses the danger tone with an icon. All colours follow the theme in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web thread shows an icon delete button on each comment and a Textarea with an Enter-to-send hint; on iOS Delete is in the comment's context menu, as messages offer actions on touch, and the reply field is MonarchMessageComposer, whose hardware-keyboard Return sends. The web mutes a resolved thread's text; iOS keeps the message rows' colours and marks the state with a Resolved badge and the spoken value. The web moves focus to the first revealed reply; iOS announces how many replies were shown. Comment bodies are plain text on iOS; the web accepts rich content. Android has no comment thread yet. Status experimental: it is a product composite until a Rook app adopts it.
accessibility: The thread is a container named "Thread started by" and the first author, with the value Resolved while resolved.
The quote is one element read as "Quoted text" with the passage as its value.
Each comment is a MonarchMessageRow read as author, full date and time, and text; Delete is in its context menu, available through the VoiceOver actions.
Showing folded replies announces "3 earlier replies shown"; resolving, reopening, posting a reply and a failure are announced.
A failure is an icon and text, not colour alone; the resolved state is a badge with a check and text.
Every button is at least 44 points; the reply field is named Reply.
edgeCases: With visibleReplies at 0 every reply folds; a negative value counts as 0.
Exactly one reply more than visibleReplies is shown rather than folded behind a button for one item.
A reply of only spaces and line breaks is not posted.
Long names and bodies wrap; the top row lets the quote wrap beside the button.
New replies arriving while folded stay visible because the latest replies are always shown.

examples.title: Open thread with a quote
examples.template:
MonarchCommentThread(
    comments,
    quote: {{quote}},
    isResolved: isResolved,
    now: {{now|date}},
    onResolvedChange: { isResolved = $0 },
    onDelete: { id in comments.removeAll { $0.id == id } },
    onReply: { text in
        comments.append(
            MonarchCommentThreadComment(id: UUID().uuidString, author: "Lee Park", body: text, createdAt: .now)
        )
    }
)
examples.setup:
@State private var isResolved = false
@State private var comments = [
    MonarchCommentThreadComment(
        id: "c1",
        author: "Priya Raman",
        body: "Should this say \"billed every quarter\" instead?",
        createdAt: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_773_133_920),
        seed: "u1"
    ),
    MonarchCommentThreadComment(
        id: "c2",
        author: "Tom Becker",
        body: "Yes. Monthly billing was retired last year.",
        createdAt: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_773_135_600),
        seed: "u2",
        canDelete: true
    ),
]
examples.code:
MonarchCommentThread(
    comments,
    quote: "Billed monthly, cancel any time.",
    isResolved: isResolved,
    now: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_773_144_000),
    onResolvedChange: { isResolved = $0 },
    onDelete: { id in comments.removeAll { $0.id == id } },
    onReply: { text in
        comments.append(
            MonarchCommentThreadComment(id: UUID().uuidString, author: "Lee Park", body: text, createdAt: .now)
        )
    }
)

examples.title: Read only, with older replies folded
examples.code:
MonarchCommentThread(
    (0..<6).map { (index: Int) -> MonarchCommentThreadComment in
        MonarchCommentThreadComment(
            id: "\(index)",
            author: index == 0 ? "Lee Park" : "Tom Becker",
            body: index == 0 ? "Can we drop the footnote?" : "Reply \(index)",
            createdAt: Date(timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate: 800_000_000).addingTimeInterval(TimeInterval(index * 300))
        )
    },
    visibleReplies: 2,
    now: Date(timeIntervalSinceReferenceDate: 800_003_600)
)
